Title: 02. Finance - General Ledger UST Led Workshop - 28/Sep/2026
Description: Finance and Operations process-modeling workshop for Dynamics 365 Finance general ledger: F&O navigation; chart of accounts and main accounts; financial dimensions (business unit, profit center, cost center); fiscal calendar and ledger period control; currencies and revaluation overview; account structures and advanced rules. Accrual/deferral management and ledger allocations were deferred to a follow-up session.

Title: Configure a global chart of accounts shared across legal entities
Description: As a chief accountant, I need to configure a single global chart of accounts in Dynamics 365 Finance that is shared across all Heartstream legal entities, so that GL account definitions stay consistent for consolidation and group reporting.
Acceptance Criteria:
- One chart of accounts is defined and associated with all in-scope legal entities
- Main accounts in active use from the Heartstream COA extract are loaded for cutover (not the full legacy Philips catalog)
- Legal entities can post to the shared COA subject to account-level restrictions configured per entity

Title: Restrict selected main accounts to designated legal entities
Description: As a financial controller, I need to restrict specific main accounts to designated legal entities (for example KPNC or region-specific tax accounts), so that sensitive or statutory accounts are not mis-posted in other company codes.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Main accounts identified as legal-entity-specific cannot be selected on transactions in other legal entities
- US holding-company-only accounts (for example KPNC reporting) are limited to the US holding legal entity
- India GST or other region-specific tax accounts are limited to the India legal entity pending tax workshop confirmation (DQ-GL-003)

Title: Map main account categories for out-of-box financial reporting
Description: As a management reporting lead, I need to map main accounts to D365 main account categories that align with Heartstream financial statement groupings, so that standard financial reports can be used with minimal customization.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Each active main account is assigned a main account type and main account category
- Category mapping supports balance sheet and P&L groupings equivalent to financial statement item and reporting item hierarchies from consolidation
- Gaps between Philips POCA/FS item groupings and D365 categories are documented for offline mapping workshops

Title: Suspend unused legacy main accounts after cutover
Description: As a chief accountant, I need to suspend main accounts that exist only for legacy SAP manual/automated duplication but are not required in D365, so that the active COA stays manageable without losing one-to-one cutover mapping initially.
Acceptance Criteria:
- At cutover, in-use main accounts from Heartstream are imported with a one-to-one match to current SAP usage
- Main accounts not required in D365 can be marked suspended so they cannot be used on new transactions
- A later cleanup phase can retire suspended accounts without breaking opening-balance migration

Title: Block manual general journal posting to sub-ledger control accounts
Description: As a financial controller, I need to configure bank and other sub-ledger control main accounts to disallow manual general journal entry, so that postings flow through the appropriate sub-ledger modules and reconcile cleanly to GL.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Selected bank and sub-ledger main accounts have Do not allow manual entry enabled
- Users post bank activity through cash and bank transactions that update the sub-ledger and GL automatically
- Attempting to use a blocked account on a general journal is rejected with a clear validation message

Title: Require approval before activating new main accounts
Description: As a chief accountant, I need to require an approval-controlled process before a new main account is created or an existing Philips code is opened for Heartstream company codes, so that COA growth stays governed.
Acceptance Criteria:
- New main account requests require chief accountant (or delegate) approval before the account is active for posting
- Opening an existing unused code from the parent chart follows the same approval path
- Approved accounts are created in D365 with required type, category, and dimension rules applied

Title: Omit main-account-level totaling on trial balance
Description: As a financial controller, I need to run trial balance inquiry without main-account-level totaling lines, so that reviewers can validate double-entry balance without extra subtotal rows that caused confusion in legacy reporting.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Trial balance for main accounts does not insert asset/expense subtotal rows at individual account level
- Financial statement and management reports still show section and hierarchy totals
- Users can opt into D365 totaling features only if a future review finds them useful

Title: Configure business unit profit center and cost center dimensions
Description: As a finance functional lead, I need to configure business unit, profit center, and cost center as financial dimensions in D365 Finance, so that operational postings match Heartstream management and consolidation hierarchies.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Financial dimensions exist for business unit, profit center, and cost center with values loaded from approved master data
- Dimension values reflect global master data where standardized across legal entities
- Legal-entity-specific cost center values are supported where R&D or other functions do not exist in all entities

Title: Standardize cost center master data across legal entities
Description: As a chief accountant, I need to manage cost centers with a standardized structure and nomenclature across legal entities where possible, so that authorization and maintenance are not duplicated company code by company code.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Shared cost center values use consistent numbering and naming across legal entities where the function exists
- Cost centers that are legal-entity-specific remain restricted to that entity
- Finance can maintain cost centers centrally rather than only through per-company-code matrices where D365 global dimension configuration allows

Title: Represent functional area for consolidated P and L reporting
Description: As a finance business partner, I need to represent functional area (manufacturing, selling, G&A, R&D) for reporting and posting control, either as a financial dimension or as a deterministic attribute of cost center, so that consolidated P&L views match Heartstream expectations.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Functional area is available on expense-related transactions for reporting consistent with cost center ranges (for example 1000 manufacturing, 2000 selling, 3000 G&A, 5000 R&D)
- Design choice between separate dimension vs cost-center-derived mapping is documented (DQ-GL-002)
- GL accounts that must not post to incompatible functional areas are enforceable through account structure rules

Title: Enforce account structure rules for dimension combinations
Description: As a financial controller, I need to configure account structure and advanced rules that restrict which financial dimension values can post to which main account ranges, so that users cannot book COGS to finance cost centers or violate similar policy rules.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Account structures cover active main account ranges with required dimension segments
- Invalid dimension combinations are blocked at transaction entry
- Advanced rules add conditional dimensions (for example worker on travel accounts) only where needed without adding global dimensions

Title: Default profit center and cost center on SCM-driven transactions
Description: As a finance operations lead, I need to default profit center and cost center on sales, purchase, and inventory transactions from product and site setup, so that material-level activity rolls up to the correct management hierarchy.
Acceptance Criteria:
- SCM integration can populate profit center on order and inventory transactions per agreed material and site mapping
- Financial dimensions on sales order lines are defaulted or mandatory per configuration
- Detailed material-to-profit-center mapping is confirmed with SCM workstream (DQ-GL-008)

Title: Limit active financial dimensions for performance
Description: As a solution architect, I need to limit the implemented set of active financial dimensions to a small approved list (target approximately four to five), so that transaction entry and reporting performance remain acceptable.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Approved dimension list for phase 1 is documented and excludes optional dimensions unless justified
- Additional reporting attributes use financial tags or BI where they are not needed on trial balance
- Dimension count review is part of solution sign-off before UAT

Title: Align all legal entities to a single fiscal calendar at go-live
Description: As a group controller, I need to align all Heartstream legal entities including India and Australia on one fiscal calendar with a December year-end before go-live, so that period close and consolidation timelines are aligned.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Fiscal calendar configuration uses one calendar for all in-scope legal entities at go-live
- India completes transition from March year-end to December year-end before go-live as planned
- Australia remains on December year-end aligned with the group

Title: Allow controlled posting to prior periods after soft close
Description: As a financial controller, I need to reopen prior fiscal periods in a controlled manner for correcting entries, so that month-end close discipline is maintained without permanent lock-out.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Closed periods use on-hold or equivalent soft-close status rather than permanent close by default
- Only authorized users can reopen a prior period module or ledger for posting
- Reopened period postings are auditable (user, date, period)

Title: Close AR and AP modules before general ledger period
Description: As a financial controller, I need to configure ledger calendar status to close customer and vendor sub-ledgers while GL remains open for adjustments, so that sub-ledger close on working day 2 and GL close on working day 4 can be enforced.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Ledger calendar supports module-level period status per legal entity
- AR and AP modules can be set on hold while GL remains open for the same period
- Posting to closed AR or AP modules is blocked for users without override access

Title: Maintain monthly exchange rates shared across company codes
Description: As a treasury lead, I need to maintain exchange rates updated monthly and available to all company codes that share rate types, so that revaluation and translation use consistent rates group-wide.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Exchange rate types required for Heartstream (including legacy actuals types) are configured
- Monthly rates can be entered or imported once and consumed by all relevant legal entities
- Decision on automated Oanda or other provider integration is recorded (DQ-GL-004)

Title: Run foreign currency revaluation across GL and sub-ledgers
Description: As a financial controller, I need to run foreign currency revaluation processes for GL, AR, AP, and bank balances, so that month-end balances reflect closing rates in our multi-currency environment.
Acceptance Criteria:
- GL revaluation can be simulated and posted for balance sheet and income statement accounts as configured
- AR, AP, and bank foreign currency revaluation routines are executable per legal entity
- Revaluation postings can be reversed when required

Title: Track month-end close tasks in period close workspace
Description: As a financial controller, I need to track month-end close checklist activities in D365 period close workspace (sub-ledger close, recurring accruals, reconciliations, forex routines), so that the lean finance team can see status across company codes.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Period close workspace lists tasks aligned to Heartstream month-end checklist categories
- Tasks can be assigned and marked complete per legal entity and period
- Manual recurring accrual journals remain supported until accrual automation is defined (DQ-GL-005)

Title: Configure segregation of duties through security roles
Description: As a chief accountant, I need to configure D365 Finance security roles so invoice processing, payment processing, and GL posting can be separated by user despite a small finance team, so that internal control expectations are met.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Security roles are assigned per user with documented SoD intent (for example AP entry vs payment vs GL)
- Users without role access cannot reach restricted workspaces or journals
- Role design is validated in UAT with named finance team members

Title: Use identifiable voucher number sequences for intercompany journals
Description: As a financial controller, I need to assign a dedicated number sequence prefix to intercompany general journals, so that intercompany vouchers are easy to identify in GL inquiry and reconciliation.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Intercompany journal name uses a dedicated number sequence (for example Interco prefix)
- Posted intercompany vouchers display the configured prefix
- Number sequences are consistent across legal entities that use the shared intercompany journal setup

Title: Print customer invoices in local language per customer
Description: As a regional finance user, I need to print customer invoice documents in the customer's required local language (for example China or Japan), so that statutory and customer-facing documents are acceptable in each market.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Customer master supports a document language preference independent of company default language
- Customer invoices render in the language defined on the customer when local language is required
- Legal-entity language still drives localization features such as tax statements per country

Title: Finance GL features missing from ADO feature catalog
Description:
Risk: Generated GL user stories cannot be linked to catalog Feature work items because feature.json contains no GL-specific Feature titles.
Impact: ADO import will have blank Feature IDs until catalog Features are authored for WS-02 GL scope.
Mitigation: Add Epic/Feature hierarchy for Record-to-Report GL in ADO and re-run work-item mapping.
